visual_review.method: Direct full-size view_image inspection of all exported first/middle/end PNGs; no manual OS interaction claim.

findings.finding: Body projection is broadly near the observed address pose, but the long blue rig/seed extension points down-left while the visible white club points down-right; anatomical and club identity remain unqualified.

The follow-through retains a conspicuous upper-body/arm mismatch and long yellow residuals between green observations and blue projected geometry. The source-sized overlay and research caption are readable; selected matched RMS is 59.36 px.

The blue torso and arm projection partly follows the walking pose, but the long blue seed extension points right whereas the visible club shaft points down-left. Feet lie outside the crop, preventing visual contact assessment.

visual_review.legend_and_caption: Existing green observations, blue native rig/seeds and yellow residuals remain explicit. Camera/anatomy unqualified and physical time unknown labels are visible on all three stills.
visual_review.limitations: Inspection verifies presented output and mismatches, not 3D anatomy, ground contact, club attachment identity or continuous nonlinear feasibility. The scalar dense metric and selected-frame RMS use different frame selections.
